A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'chāp' 24 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) چهاپ ćhāp
                        ( p. 455 ) H چهاپ छाप ćhāp (see ćhāp-nā ), s.f. Stamp, print, copy; impression (of a stamp, or type, &c.); a seal, a signet; stamp (on coins), mark (on weights and measures to indicate their accuracy), an official stamp in general; sectarial marks representing a lotus, trident, &c., delineated on the body by the worshippers of Vishnu ( = ćhāpā ): — ćhāp karnā , ćhāp lagānā (- meṅ ), To put a seal or stamp (on), to stamp, seal, print, make an impression or mark (on). 2) چهاپا ćhāpā
                        ( p. 455 ) H چهاپا छापा ćhāpā [ ćhāp +Prk. अओ = S. अ + कः ], s.m. Stamp, print, seal, impression ( = ćhāp ); a large wooden seal with which corn in a granary is stamped (also ćhāp ); sectarial marks ( = ćhāp ); the stamp for making sectarial marks; printing; print, impression; an edition; a press; — a night-attack: — ćhāpā-ḥāṣil , s.m. A tax on stamping cloth: — ćhāpe-ḵẖāna , s.m. A printing-office; a press; — ćhāpe-ḵẖāna-wālā , s.m. Proprietor of a press: — ćhāpā karnā , v.t. = ćhāpnā , q.v.: — ćhāpe-kī āzādī , The freedom of the press: — ćhāpā lagānā (- meṅ , or - par ), To put a stamp or seal (on), to stamp, &c.: — ćhāpā lagānā = ćhāpā mārnā (- par ), To surprise (an enemy) in a night-attack: — ćhāpe-meṅ ćhapnā , To appear in print, to be published; to be exposed or defamed in print: — ćhāpe-wālā , s.m. A printer; — a pressman: — ćhāpā vidyā , The art of printing: — patthar-kā ćhāpā , s.m. Lithography. 3) چهاپتي ćhāptī
                        ( p. 455 ) H چهاپتي छापती ćhāptī [ ćhāp ( nā )+ tī = Prk. अत्तिआ = S. आपि (caus. augment)+ ति + इका (i.e. आप्ति का )], s.f. A seal or mark of cow-dung placed on a heap of grain on the threshing-floor to prevent its removal. 4) چهاپنا ćhāpnā
                        ( p. 455 ) H چهاپنا छापना ćhāpnā (caus. of ćhapnā , q.v.), v.t. To stamp, to seal; to print, bring out an impression, to publish: — ćhāp-denā , v.t. = ćhāpnā . 5) چهاپه ćhāpa
                        ( p. 455 ) H چهاپه ćhāpa , s.m. = ćhāpā , q.v. 6) چهپ ćhap
                        ( p. 457 ) H چهپ छप ćhap , s.f. = H چهپا छपा ćhapā , s.m. (prob. onomat.; but cf. ćhapnā ), The sound occasioned by the hand or a falling body striking water; a splash, squash: — ćhap-ćhap , s.f. The sound produced by striking water the splashing sound of water. 7) چهپا ćhapā
                        ( p. 457 ) H چهپا छपा ćhapā , s.m. = H چهپ छप ćhap , s.f. (prob. onomat.; but cf. ćhapnā ), The sound occasioned by the hand or a falling body striking water; a splash, squash: — ćhap-ćhap , s.f. The sound produced by striking water the splashing sound of water. 8) چهپاکا ćhapākā
                        ( p. 457 ) H چهپاکا छूपाका ćhapākā [ ćhap +Prk. अक्कओ or आकओ = S. अ + क + कः ], s.m. = ćhap , or ćhap-ćhap , q.v. 9) چهپانا ćhapānā
                        ( p. 457 ) H چهپانا छपाना ćhapānā [caus. of ćhāpnā ; — ćhapā˚ = ćhap + ā = āw = Prk. आवे = S. आपि caus. augment], v.t. To cause to be stamped, marked, or printed, to get or have printed ( = ćhapwānā ). 10) چهپائي ćhapāʼī
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپائي छपाई ćhapāʼī [ ćhapā ( nā )+ āʼī = Prk. एअव्वअइआ = S. ( इ ) तव्य + ता + इका ], s.f. Printing; impression, edition; the price or cost of printing. 11) چهپر ćhappar, ćhapar
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپر छप्पर ćhappar , (in comp.) छपर ćhapar [S. छत्त्वरः , rt. छद् ], s.m. A sloping thatch, a thatched roof; a shed, a hut; — tester of a bed); — ( fig. ) a heavy burden: — ćhappar-band , s.m. A thatcher: — ćhappar-bandī , s.f. Thatching; price of thatching; cultivating, with permanent residence (in a village): — ćhappar-par dharnā or rakhnā , v.t. 'To place on the thatch,' to throw aside as worthless, to lay aside, to care nothing for: — ćhappar phāṛ-ke denā (- ko ), 'To cleave the roof and give'; to surprise (one) with an unexpected gift; to give in a miraculous manner: — ćhappar ṭūṭ-paṛnā , 'Roof to fall in'; a sudden calamity to befal (one): — ćhappar ćhānā , ćhappar ḍālnā , To thatch; to make a roof or home (for oneself), to take up (one's) abode, to abide, to tarry: — ćhappar-khāṭ , ćhappar-khaṭ , ćhapar-khaṭ , s.m. A bedstead with a tester and curtains. 12) چهپري ćhaprī
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپري छपरी ćhaprī [ ćhap , q.v.+ rī , Prk. अडिआ = S. र + इका ], s.f. A puddle, a pool. 13) چهپڙ ćhappar
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپڙ छप्पड़ ćhappar , s.m. incorr. for ćhappar , q.v. 14) چهپك ćhapak
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپك छपक ćhapak (see ćhapaknā ), s.f. Splashing, a splash ( = ćhap , q.v.): — ćhapak-ćhapak , s.f. The sound produced by striking water ( = ćhap-ćhap ): — ćhapak-ćhapak karnā , To make a splashing noise; to splash. 15) چهپکا ćhapkā
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپکا छपका ćhapkā , s.m. A splash (of water = ćhapak ); — a net (for catching pigeons, &c.); a cage with a net attached to it. 16) چهپکانا ćhapkānā
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپکانا छपकाना ćhapkānā (causal of ćhapaknā , q.v.), v.t. To dash or throw (water); to splash. 17) چهپکنا ćhapaknā
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپکنا छपकना ćhapaknā [ ćhapak˚ = Prk. छंपक्के ( इ ), fr. S. क्षम्प् + कृ ], v.n. Water to be dashed or thrown; to be splashed; to be beaten. 18) چهپن ćhappan
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپن छप्पन ćhappan [Prk. छप्पण्मा ?; S. षद्पञ्चाशत् ], adj. Fifty-six. 19) چهپنا ćhapnā
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپنا छपना ćhapnā [ ćhap˚ = Prk. छंप ( इ ) = S. क्षम्प ( ति ), rt. क्षम्प् ], v.n. To be stamped, be marked; to be printed, be published. 20) چهپوانا ćhapwānā
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپوانا छपवाना ćhapwānā (doub. caus. of ćhāpnā ), v.t. To get or have printed, &c. ( = ćhapānā , q.v.). 21) چهپوائي ćhapwāʼī
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپوائي छपवाई ćhapwāʼī (see ćhapāʼī ), s.f. Printing; cost of printing ( = ćhapāʼī ). 22) چهپئي ćhapay, ćhapai, ćhapaʼī, ćhappaʼī
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپئي छपय ćhapay , ćhapai , छपई ćhapaʼī , छप्पई ćhappaʼī [Prk. छप्पयो ; S. षट् + पदः ], s.m. A kind of poem in Hindī verse consisting of six hemistichs. 23) چهپيا ćhapaiyā
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپيا छपैया ćhapaiyā [ ćhāp ( nā )+ aiyā = waiyā = Prk. एअव्वअइओ = S. ( इ ) तव्य + क + इकः ], s.m. A printer, a pressman ( = ćhāpne-wālā ). 24) چهپيرا ćhaperā
                        ( p. 458 ) H چهپيرا छपेरा ćhaperā [ ćhāp , q.v.+S. कार + कः ], s.m. One who prints cloth, &c. ( = ćhīpī , q.v.). Search Form • DDSA Close

A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'kahāṅ' 9 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) کاهن kāhaṅ, kāhuṅ
                        ( p. 808 ) H کاهن काहं kāhaṅ , or काहुं kāhuṅ , postpn. (dialec.) = ko , the case-sign of the dat. & acc. 2) کاهن kāhan
                        ( p. 808 ) H کاهن काहण kāhan [S. कार्षापणं ], s.m. An aggregate number consisting of sixteen paṇs , or 1,280 cowries. 3) کہان kahāṅ
                        ( p. 868 ) H کہان कहां kahāṅ [prob. S. किं + स्थाने ; H. ke-thān ], pron. adv. Where? whither?: — kahāṅ-par , Where? at what place? — kahāṅ-tak or talak , kahāṅ-lag , or kahāṅ-loṅ , How far? how long? to what degree?: — kahāṅ-se , Whence? how? by what means?: — kahāṅ-kā , Of or belonging to what place?: — kahāṅ-kā-kahāṅ , To what a degree! extremely, intensely; — from where to where; what a distance! ever so far; now here now there: — kahāṅ — kahān , Where (this) — where (that)?; how distant or how different is (this) from (that)! how little is (this) consistent with that! (e.g. kahāṅ rājā Bhoj kahāṅ Gangā telī ; — cf. Pers. kujā — kujā ). 4) کہان kahān
                        ( p. 868 ) H کہان कहाण or कहान kahān , s.m. (dialec.) = kāhan , or kahāwan , qq.v. 5) کہانا kahānā
                        ( p. 868 ) H کہانا कहाना kahānā [caus. of kahnā , q.v.; — the stem kahā = S. कथ + आपय , used as a substitute for S. caus. कथय ˚; Prk. कहाव ˚; — nā , fr. S. aff. अनीयं ; Prk. अणअं ], v.t. To cause to speak; to cause to tell, &c. ( = kahlānā , kahwānā ); — v.n. To be called or named or designated, to be dubbed; to be said to be ( = kahlānā ). 6) کہانا kahānā
                        ( p. 868 ) H کہانا कहाना kahānā [Prk. कहानअं ; S. कथानकं ], s.m. A tale; a saying, proverb (syn. kahāwat ). 7) کہانی kahānī
                        ( p. 869 ) H کہانی कहानी kahānī (dim. of kahānā , q.v.), s.f. A tale, story, fable, apologue: — kahānī joṛnā , To make up a story: — kahānī kahnā , To tell a tale or story. 8) کہن kahaṅ, kahuṅ
                        ( p. 880 ) H کہن कहं kahaṅ , or कहुं kahuṅ (dialec. & Old H. forms), postpn. = ko (the sign of the dat.-acc.), q.v. 9) کہن kahan
                        ( p. 880 ) H کہن कहन kahan [Prk. कहणं ; S. कथनं ], s.m. A saying, word; a by-word; — a composition: — kahan-sunan , s.m. Words, altercation, &c. ( = kahā-sunī ). Search Form • DDSA Close
